area_overview: ChangeTracker events around tracking and state changes.
key_ideas: Tracking fires before an entity is tracked.
Tracked fires after an entity is tracked.
StateChanging fires before an entity state changes.
StateChanged fires after an entity state changes.
Event args expose the entry/entity and information such as FromQuery, OldState, and NewState depending on event type.
Events are useful for diagnostics, audit hooks, debugging, or enforcing local context policies, but should not replace SaveChanges/interceptors for durable audit.

reading_quality.visual_reading: Events tail is compact and cohesive; all event screenshots in the P03/R03R04 candidate sheet were included.
limitations: Some examples are tiny continuation snippets, so the transcript keeps the event ordering and handler semantics rather than every exact variable name.
